responsibility: Declares the core data structures, constants, tags, and inline helpers that define GCC’s LTO bytecode format and streamer APIs. It documents the layout of streamed function bodies, defines LTO version numbers and the LTO_tags enum for trees, gimple, CFG, and EH records, and provides inline support for tag checking, tree-reference encoders, symbol-table encoders, and iterators over partitioned symtab nodes. This header is the central interface and format contract shared across LTO section, streamer, cgraph, and wrapper code.
same_name_distinction: Defines the shared LTO bytecode-format contract, enums, data structures, declarations, and inline helpers that other files include, whereas gcc/lto-streamer.cc supplies the runtime utilities and global state built on top of that interface.
